occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on information gathered through the course of the DFPS investigation, it was determined that a caregiver was not actively supervising children on the playground during a medical emergency.
